title: afterdark
profTagline: One live techno stream behind a full-screen WebGL rave, with a chroma-keyed dancer moving to the beat. Three dancers, a night stage that never lightens, tilt for 2.5D parallax.
installDesc: Opens like an app, straight into the rave
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
